title: Dry nose, cracked lips? This 58-hour humidifier — first impressions #autumn #humidifier #samsclub
description: Weather changed and my nose has been bone dry — even my lips are starting to crack. Picked up this Homedics warm and cool mist humidifier at Sam’s Club. Holds about a gallon and a quarter, runs up to 58 hours, and you can set the humidity anywhere from 35 to 55%. Remote included, batteries too. First night tonight and it already seems super quiet — 3-night verdict coming.

title: Stop toasting your bagels — fry them instead
description:
Butter both sides, medium-high pan, and let it sizzle. Crispy on the outside, soft in the middle. It’s great plain, or go all in with cream cheese, lox and capers.

My mom taught me this one, and she swears she’s a bad cook. Thanks, Mom.
